sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 2 (#1 instruction_is_a_natural_product_request) and Internal Quality Checks row 2 (no extra annotation columns)

task/environment/instructions/ui.md (sha 3de513cf...), behaviour.md (f49b3e89...), overview.md, policy.md, security.md, integration.md - hashes match manifest and current projects/colderwater-playground-devtools bytes
git show f2e52393 and 0829983e:behaviour.md (previous flagged wording)
evidence: instruction.md:1-5 is a first-person product ask with a reason ("I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source"), no lists, tables, framework or endpoint recipe. The flagged v15 defect is fixed: ui.md now contains zero 'must' (grep -c = 0) and is written as preferences with motives (ui.md:3 "I want the editor to be the playground's own", ui.md:7 "I often have one very long line", ui.md:15 "I paste a lot of compact one-line experiments"); behaviour.md has a single remaining 'must' (behaviour.md:13 "Restoring from an old page must not overwrite a newer save") versus the v15 string of must/do-not clauses, and the grader-shaped line "Send saves and restores as ordinary HTTP requests from the page" (0829983e) is now behaviour.md:13 "I keep the browser's network panel open while I debug, so please make saves and restores ordinary HTTP requests from the page that I can see there", a user-side motive with no mention of replay or grading. Same requirements were preserved (no loosening observed in the diff of meaning). No numbered acceptance list, shall/must table, feature matrix or build recipe exists in any of the seven files; integration.md is the template's runtime-contract note in the template's own impersonal style. Residual risk (why risk=true): ui.md remains very dense with QA-derived edge cases phrased as wishes (ui.md:7 "if my selection ends at the very start of the next line, leave that next line alone"; ui.md:11 "Replace current should never land on text it has just put in"; ui.md:9 "Formatting a file that is already formatted should change nothing and add no Undo step"; behaviour.md:5 per-interaction five-second budgets), and security.md:3 ("must not be able to reach the network ... must fail") and policy.md:5 ("Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract") keep an impersonal spec voice. These do not meet the row's defect definition, but a strict hosted reviewer that already flagged this row once could read the ui.md density as a checklist rewritten in prose; that is a style risk, not a demonstrated defect. No portal result for v16 exists, so the fix is unmeasured on the portal.
suggested_fix: Optional polish, not required to pass: soften security.md:3 and policy.md:5 into the requester's voice (e.g. 'I don't want snippets I run to reach the network...'; 'treat these notes as what I need, not exact selectors') so the voice is uniform across notes; do not drop any requirement.
